Lola, could you inventory and restock the beverage aisle?
I want to make sure our full range of beverages is on display.
Sure, but I can tell you offhand that I checked the stockroom yesterday, and we're out of Refresh Limited's flavored iced teas.
I saw the truck leave about an hour ago.
Oh, okay.
By the way, any word on my request for time off?
Did you put in a request?
Yeah, I emailed you yesterday.

哦，好的。
顺便问一下我的休假申请怎么样了？
你提交了吗？
是的，我昨天给你发邮件了。
